name: Valhalla Copybot
description: Valhalla Mech memecoin copy trading. Google AI Studio Gemini. Paper by default. No transfer or withdraw.

GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY.label: Google AI Studio Key
GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY.help: AI Studio API key for Gemini. This plugin does not use Vertex AI.

VALHALLA_LIVE_TRADING.label: Live Trading
VALHALLA_LIVE_TRADING.help: Set to the exact text true to allow swaps from the bot wallet. Any other value keeps the plugin in paper mode.

VALHALLA_PUBKEY.label: Trader Public Key
VALHALLA_PUBKEY.help: Public address of the bot wallet. Used only for a live swap.

HELIUS_API_KEY.label: Helius API Key
HELIUS_API_KEY.help: Optional Solana RPC key. Public RPC is used when this is empty. The key is not stored in the repo.

BIRDEYE_API_KEY.label: Birdeye API Key
BIRDEYE_API_KEY.help: Optional read-only price fallback. DexScreener is the primary mark.
